class.name: AuthentikClient
class.brief_description: Non-blocking OpenID Connect (OIDC) and Authentik OAuth 2.0 client.
class.description: [AuthentikClient] implements OpenID Connect discovery (with automatic Authentik [code]/application/o/<slug>/[/code] endpoint derivation), Authorization Code + PKCE ([code]S256[/code]) loopback login, Device Authorization Grant login, UserInfo enrichment, token refresh, revocation, and AES-256 encrypted session storage.

method.name: cancel_login
method.description: Cancels an in-progress login operation and closes any loopback callback listener.

method.name: clear_stored_session
method.description: Deletes the persisted encrypted session file on disk, if present.

method.name: complete_authorization_callback
method.description: Completes a pending PKCE login using a redirect URL or query string captured from a custom URI scheme handler.

method.name: fetch_userinfo
method.description: Fetches claims from the OIDC UserInfo endpoint and merges them into the current [AuthentikSession].

method.name: get_access_token
method.description: Returns the raw access token of the current session, or an empty string if unauthenticated.

method.name: get_authorization_header
method.description: Returns an HTTP [code]Authorization[/code] header string for the current session.

method.name: get_bearer_token
method.description: Returns the preferred JWT bearer token from the current session.

method.name: get_endpoints
method.description: Returns a dictionary containing the resolved OIDC endpoint URLs.

method.name: get_last_authorization_url
method.description: Returns the most recently generated browser authorization URL.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the last [enum AuthError] recorded by this client.

method.name: get_last_error_message
method.description: Returns the human-readable message for [method get_last_error].

method.name: get_session
method.description: Returns the current [AuthentikSession], or [code]null[/code] if unauthenticated.

method.name: get_status
method.description: Returns the current [enum Status] of the client state machine.

method.name: get_user_code
method.description: Returns the active RFC 8628 user verification code during [constant STATUS_AWAITING_DEVICE_CODE].

method.name: get_verification_uri
method.description: Returns the verification URL where the user enters [method get_user_code].

method.name: get_verification_uri_complete
method.description: Returns the verification URL pre-populated with the user code, if provided by the server.

method.name: has_any_group
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the active session belongs to at least one group in [param groups].

method.name: has_entitlement
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the active session includes [param entitlement].

method.name: has_group
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the active session belongs to [param group].

method.name: is_authenticated
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a valid, non-expired session is loaded.

method.name: is_busy
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when an asynchronous authentication request is in flight.

method.name: is_configured
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if both [member issuer_url] and [member client_id] are non-empty.

method.name: load_session
method.description: Loads an encrypted session from [member storage_path]. Automatically triggers [method refresh_session] if the access token is expired and a refresh token is available.

method.name: login_device_code
method.description: Begins a Device Authorization Grant flow (RFC 8628).

method.name: login_interactive
method.description: Begins an Authorization Code + PKCE flow (RFC 7636).

method.name: logout
method.description: Signs out of the active session and clears persisted credentials.

method.name: poll
method.description: Polls active HTTP requests, loopback TCP sockets,device-code timers, and automatic token refresh.

method.name: refresh_session
method.description: Exchanges the current session's refresh token for a fresh access token.

method.name: save_session
method.description: Saves the current session encrypted with AES-256 to [member storage_path].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], automatically refreshes expiring sessions within [member refresh_leeway_sec] seconds of expiry.
OAuth 2.0 public client identifier configured in Authentik or another OIDC provider.
Maximum time in seconds to wait for interactive browser sign-in before timing out.
If [code]true[/code], persists sessions to [member storage_path] using AES-256 encryption.
TCP port on [code]127.0.0.1[/code] for the loopback callback server ([code]0[/code] binds an ephemeral port).
Optional explicit redirect URI overriding the automatic [code]http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback[/code] URI.
Number of seconds before token expiration at which automatic refresh is triggered.
Space-separated OAuth 2.0 scopes requested during authorization.
File path used for encrypted session storage. Defaults to [code]user://authentik_session.dat[/code] when empty.
If [code]true[/code], verifies TLS certificates on HTTPS requests to the identity provider.

signal.name: authentication_failed
signal.description: Emitted when authentication or token refresh fails.

signal.name: authorization_url_ready
signal.description: Emitted when the browser authorization URL is ready.

signal.name: device_code_received
signal.description: Emitted when device authorization codes are received from the provider.

signal.name: logged_out
signal.description: Emitted when the session is cleared via [method logout].

signal.name: session_refreshed
signal.description: Emitted when tokens are refreshed via [method refresh_session].

signal.name: state_changed
signal.description: Emitted whenever the client's [enum Status] changes.

signal.name: userinfo_received
signal.description: Emitted when profile and group claims are fetched from the OIDC UserInfo endpoint.
